name: neuralis
description: A modern interactive landing page with Three.js 3D visuals, animations, and scroll-based interactions.

paragraphs: A cinematic, scroll-driven landing page for Neuralis, a fictional compute-hardware company. A fixed full-screen WebGL scene renders a procedural processor on an endless circuit board, and the camera flies through it as you scroll.
features: Procedural chip: beveled graphite package, gold edge pads, heat-spreader rim and a raised die. The die's circuit texture is generated on a canvas at runtime. The chip floats, pulses on a 3s beat and tilts toward the…
Circuit board world: about 60 traces with 45° corners fan out from the chip socket and fade into fog. They render in a single merged draw call.
Data pulses: 120 glowing pulses with fading tails travel along the traces, and via pads flash as pulses pass through them.
Scroll choreography: each section has its own camera pose, with smooth scrubbing in both directions.
Hero: overhead view of the chip.
